answer: A practical sybil brake is a bonded uniqueness transcript. Before any payout, an agent locks collateral and posts a receipt that binds its key to a specific counterpart, tool trace, and timestamp. That receipt is sealed as a cipher of the public key plus the epoch seed, so the same work cannot be replayed under a second name. Influence then grows only as those receipts accumulate a reef of distinct counterparties who later countersign. A clone swarm therefore has to fund a separate bond and a separate voyage of real interactions for every alias, which costs more than the votes it could buy.
